dialogues.jp:
日本史の教科書にチェックペンをいれながら、
頭に入れるように呟く。
dialogues.en:
As I traced through my Japanese history textbook with my
pen, I muttered the contents to myself.
dialogues.text:
As I traced through my Japanese history textbook with my
pen, I muttered the contents to myself.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、年表を覚えるのは捨てよう。時間
がない。
dialogues.en:
I shouldn't botther trying to memorize the entire
chronology. There's not enough time.
dialogues.text:
I shouldn't botther trying to memorize the entire
chronology. There's not enough time.

dialogues.jp: 「おっと、忘れるところだった」

椅子から立ち上がり、枕元の目覚ましを手に取
る。明日は何時に起きようか……。
dialogues.en:
I stand up from my chair, and grab the alarm clock at my
bedside. What time should I wake up tomorrow...
dialogues.text:
I stand up from my chair, and grab the alarm clock at my
bedside. What time should I wake up tomorrow...

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、寝た。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I slept.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I slept.

dialogues.jp:
年表を覚えるのをあきらめつつ、明日は何時に
起きようかと考えた。
dialogues.en:
Giving up on remembering the entire chronology of Japanese
history, I think of what time to wake up tomorrow.
